body:
Episcopalians alone can’t solve Episcopal problems; Methodists alone can’t solve Methodist problems, and so on. That’s because the problems we need to solve are bigger than Lutheranism, Orthodoxy, Presbyterianism, or Catholicism. We have Christian problems, and so our future must be more connected and collaborative than our past.

 – The Great Spiritual Migration (available NOW, 2016)
